resources.string: Place the wallpaper subject in front of your selected Hecker clock. All Hecker clock styles are supported.
Smoothly reveal the clock and depth layers when the screen turns on. Motion pauses on AOD and in Battery Saver.
Choose a photo for automatic extraction, or import a background and transparent PNG subject. Adjust the subject in the preview. Your clock style stays selected.
The complete wallpaper behind the clock.
A PNG cutout aligned with the background, with transparent space around the subject.
Could not prepare these layers. Use a transparent PNG subject, or extract a subject from a photo, and check the preview.
